body:
A diff over the model's token limit is reviewed a file at a time, and each of
those calls is given a context seeded from that one file. `_prepare_code_context`
takes every changed path in a single pass review and one path per call in a file
by file review, so the traversal it does never spans two changed files. Anything
that only shows up between them cannot be found, on exactly the changes where a
reader is least able to find it by hand.

A change of 6,180 added lines across 41 files was approved with no inline
comments at all. A later pass over an incremental delta of that same branch,
a fraction of the size, produced two. The reviewer found more in a small piece
of the change than in the whole of it.

The evidence and the readers are the same on both paths, so this is the seed set
rather than a missing capability.

## Checklist

- [ ] Seed the traversal from every changed path, whichever review strategy runs
- [ ] Give each per-file call the resulting view, rather than one built from its
      own file
- [ ] Establish what the file limit should be when the seeds are the whole change
      rather than one file

## Acceptance criteria

- A change where one edited file breaks a caller in another edited file is
  reported, at a size that takes the file by file path
title: fix(code-reviewer): Give a large diff a view across the whole change

body:
The core has no storage-neutral contract for extracting and comparing versioned interface definitions. Add extensible models and protocols so adapters can describe contract elements and deterministic compatibility evidence without binding consumers to a schema language, parser, repository provider, or persistence engine.

Constraint: Core does not parse a specific contract format or decide compatibility policy for an adapter. Contract content remains immutable and content-addressed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Add immutable contract documents with format, media type, content hash, revision, and properties
- [ ] Add extracted contract elements with stable identities, kinds, and properties
- [ ] Add contract snapshots that preserve source document identity
- [ ] Add compatibility changes with classification, severity, affected elements, and evidence
- [ ] Add extraction and comparison protocols
- [ ] Add validation for hashes, identities, confidence, and comparison endpoints
- [ ] Add a minimal in-memory adapter for contract and consumer tests
- [ ] Cover additive, breaking, renamed, removed, unsupported, and unchanged results
title: feat(contracts): Define versioned contract analysis interfaces
